messages:
Maria Chen: Quick ops q — finalizing the opt-in flow for the Serverless Inference webinar next Tues. Need confirmation on two things: 1) gated asset tagging (webinar vs benchmark) on registration submit, and 2) on-demand delivery email + hosted link TTL. @Leo Park can you confirm the HubSpot property names we should set? :pray:

Leo Park: For HubSpot set 'redwood_event' = 'serverless-inference-mar2026' and 'lead_asset' = 'webinar-on-demand'. We'll also add 'asset_tag' = 'marketing:benchmark' for segmenting.

Samir Gupta: For Zoom recording, we should ensure cloud recording toggle is on, and that the recording auto-uploads to GDrive/Transcribe job. Ops-bot will post the link when available.

Jen Ortiz: Ops note: our Zap currently does registration -> hubspot contact update -> add to list -> webhook to LMS. Update the webhook payload to include asset_tag. Current mapping:
```
{
  "email": "{{email}}",
  "first_name": "{{firstName}}",
  "event": "{{eventName}}",
  "hubspot_props": {"redwood_event":"..."}
}
```
I'll push a PR to the zap next hour.

Paul Nguyen: For on-demand TTL — marketing prefers 90 days open link, but gated for logged-in members after 14 days. So public hosted replay link -> 90d, gated download -> 14d. Is that doable?

Leo Park: Yes. We can create two paths: public player on CDN with query param expires=90, and gated download asset behind auth/expiring-signed-url 14d.

Maria Chen: Perfect. Who owns the post-event follow-up email copy? I'll draft initial copy and share. Need a short CTA for 'benchmark pack' and 3 CTAs: watch replay, download slides, request a demo.

Paul Nguyen: I'll take nurture sequencing: immediate replay email, 3-day follow-up with benchmark highlight, 10-day offer for demo. Add tagging for MQL if they click 'request a demo'.

Samir Gupta: Recording/upload checklist:
- Cloud recording enabled
- Auto-transcribe
- Start recording manually at 1min in (Zoom sometimes misses intro)
- Ops-bot should post link to #marketing when GDrive upload complete

ops-bot: Recording uploaded: https://drive.google.com/recording/1AbcXYZ (this is a placeholder until real link)

Jen Ortiz: PR merged for Zap mapping — added 'asset_tag' & 'event_slug'. Testing now.

Maria Chen: Draft email posted here: https://docs.google.com/... (shared). Comments welcome, target send = Wed 9am PT.

Leo Park: FYI HubSpot property created: redwood_event, lead_asset, asset_tag.

Paul Nguyen: Sequencing set in HubSpot. Tagging rule: if clicked_demo -> add to 'sales:demo' and notify sales@redwood.ai via workflow.

Maria Chen: Thanks all. Small follow-up: need anon analytics for playback views (CDN). @Samir can you add playback event to Snowplow/segment?

Samir Gupta: Yep I'll add event 'webinar_playback_started' with props: event_slug, user_type, referrer.

Maria Chen: Awesome. I'll close this thread once ops confirms final links are live. :thumbsup:

Jen Ortiz: All green from Zap side. Will ping again once CDN signed URLs are ready.

Paul Nguyen: LGTM

Leo Park: LGTM

Maria Chen: Closing in 24h unless objections.
